title.zh: 法国四大金融监管机构呼吁MiCA允许第三方提供稳定币奖励，与欧洲央行立场相左
title.en: 法国四大金融监管机构呼吁MiCA允许第三方提供稳定币奖励，与欧洲央行立场相左

current_state.zh: France's Treasury, AMF, Banque de France and ACPR urged EU lawmakers to let third parties such as crypto exchanges pay conditional rewards on stablecoin holdings while keeping the ban on issuer-paid interest, setting them against the ECB's call to extend the prohibition to third-party rewards, lending and staking.
current_state.en: France's Treasury, AMF, Banque de France and ACPR urged EU lawmakers to let third parties such as crypto exchanges pay conditional rewards on stablecoin holdings while keeping the ban on issuer-paid interest, setting them against the ECB's call to extend the prohibition to third-party rewards, lending and staking.
